LightningComponentBundle.description: Display an at-a-glance pill indicator with an avatar and label for use on record pages or in flows.

property.name: indText
property.label: Static Text
property.description: (Optional) Text shown on the indicator avatar. NOTE: Displays first 3 characters / emojis.

property.name: indIcon
property.label: Icon
property.description: (Optional) The Lightning Design System icon from https://lightningdesignsystem.com/icons/ when being used instead of Text or Image URL.

property.name: indImage
property.label: Image
property.description: (Optional) The URL to the image for the indicator avatar.

property.name: indBadgePillText
property.label: Pill Label
property.description: The text shown as the pill label.

property.name: indAltText
property.label: Alternative Text
property.description: Accessible alternative text for the indicator avatar icon.

property.name: indBackgroundColor
property.label: Background Color
property.description: (Optional) Override the background color of the indicator avatar.

property.name: indForegroundColor
property.label: Foreground Color
property.description: (Optional) Override the foreground color of the indicator avatar icon.

property.name: indTextColor
property.label: Text Color
property.description: (Optional) Override the pill label text color. Ignored when the pill is clickable, which always uses the link color.
